title: Modulation of Neural Circuits and Behavior Conference
level: Researchers (as stated on the conference page)
about: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference "Modulation of Neural Circuits and Behavior" takes place from 30 May to 4 June 2027 at the Rey Don Jaime Grand Hotel in Castelldefels (Barcelona), Spain. Applications are submitted through the conference page on grc.org.
